overall: Board did not violate the OML: emailing a draft guest column to a quorum was an administrative distribution of a document to be discussed at the meeting, though a 2018 notice says Boelter may supersede this in part.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged a selectman emailed a draft newspaper opinion piece to a quorum of the Board before a meeting to review it, outside an open meeting.
allegations.key_passage: By performing this administrative task by email, Selectman Fay did not violate the Open Meeting Law.
